title: Alternatives to Capitalism with Nomaan X
summary: Kahran and Nomaan dig into how value gets defined under capitalism — money versus societal contribution, who decides what science and technology should be built, and why expertise shouldn't become authority. They also turn to disempowerment in institutions, performative committees in universities, and Nomaan's free-market experiments where money is removed from the exchange entirely.

intents.display: to think about alternatives to capitalism and what value really means
